commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.momentumFunctions
commands.text:
noncomputable def momentumFunctions (L : ℕ) : MomentumSpace L ≃ₗ[ℂ] (Ch01.Band L → ℂ) :=
  WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ (Ch01.Band L → ℂ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.analysisEuclidean
commands.text:
noncomputable def analysisEuclidean (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : PositionSpace L →ₗ[ℂ] MomentumSpace L :=
  (momentumFunctions L).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    ((analysis L (A01.canonicalRoot L)).comp (positionFunctions L).toLinearMap)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.synthesisEuclidean
commands.text:
noncomputable def synthesisEuclidean (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : MomentumSpace L →ₗ[ℂ] PositionSpace L :=
  (positionFunctions L).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    ((synthesis L (A01.canonicalRoot L)).comp (momentumFunctions L).toLinearMap)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.unitaryFourier
commands.text:
noncomputable def unitaryFourier (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : PositionSpace L →ₗ[ℂ] MomentumSpace L :=
  (A01.normalization L : ℂ) • analysisEuclidean L

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.inverseUnitaryFourier
commands.text:
noncomputable def inverseUnitaryFourier (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : MomentumSpace L →ₗ[ℂ] PositionSpace L :=
  (A01.normalization L : ℂ) • synthesisEuclidean L

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch03.transportPositionOperator
commands.text:
noncomputable def transportPositionOperator (L : ℕ)
    (A : Module.End ℂ (Ch01.Lattice L → ℂ)) : Module.End ℂ (PositionSpace L) :=
  (positionFunctions L).symm.toLinearMap.comp (A.comp (positionFunctions L).toLinearMap)

Bosonize.Ch03.analysisEuclidean_adjoint.text: lemma analysisEuclidean_adjoint (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : (analysisEuclidean L).adjoint = synthesisEuclidean L

Bosonize.Ch03.analysisEuclidean_synthesi.text: lemma analysisEuclidean_synthesisEuclidean (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : (analysisEuclidean L).comp (synthesisEuclidean L) = (L : ℂ) • LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_apply.text: lemma analysis_apply (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (f : Ch01.Lattice L → K) (k : Ch01.Band L) : analysis L ζ f k = ∑ x : Ch01.Lattice L, f x * A01.integerCharacter ζ (-k.val) (x.val : ℤ)

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_backward_diff.text: lemma analysis_backward_diff (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (f : Ch01.Lattice L → K) (k : Ch01.Band L) : analysis L ζ (Ch02.backwardDiff f) k = (1 - ζ ^ (-k.val)) * analysis L ζ f k

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_bijective.text: lemma analysis_bijective (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (hLK : (L : K) ≠ 0) : Function.Bijective (analysis L ζ)

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_delta_zero.text: lemma analysis_delta_zero (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) : analysis L ζ (Pi.single (0 : Ch01.Lattice L) 1) = fun _ ↦ 1

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_eq_dft.text: lemma analysis_eq_dft (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (f : Ch01.Lattice L → ℂ) (k : Ch01.Band L) : analysis L (A01.canonicalRoot L) f k = ZMod.dft f (Ch01.bandProjection L k)

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_forward_diff.text: lemma analysis_forward_diff (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (f : Ch01.Lattice L → K) (k : Ch01.Band L) : analysis L ζ (Ch02.forwardDiff f) k = (ζ ^ k.val - 1) * analysis L ζ f k

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_laplacian.text: lemma analysis_laplacian (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (f : Ch01.Lattice L → K) (k : Ch01.Band L) : analysis L ζ (Ch02.laplacian f) k = (ζ ^ k.val + ζ ^ (-k.val) - 2) * analysis L ζ f k

Bosonize.Ch03.analysis_synthesis.text: lemma analysis_synthesis (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) : (analysis L ζ).comp (synthesis L ζ) = (L : K) • LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.backward_diff_character.text: lemma backward_diff_character (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Band L) : Ch02.backwardDiff (A01.bandCharacter L ζ k) = (1 - ζ ^ (-k.val)) • A01.bandCharacter L ζ k

Bosonize.Ch03.canonical_laplacian_disper.text: lemma canonical_laplacian_dispersion (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (k : ℤ) : A01.canonicalRoot L ^ k + A01.canonicalRoot L ^ (-k) - 2 = ((-4 * Real.sin (Real.pi * (k : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)

Bosonize.Ch03.forward_diff_character.text: lemma forward_diff_character (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Band L) : Ch02.forwardDiff (A01.bandCharacter L ζ k) = (ζ ^ k.val - 1) • A01.bandCharacter L ζ k

Bosonize.Ch03.inverse_analysis_eq_inv_df.text: lemma inverse_analysis_eq_inv_dft (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (g : Ch01.Band L → ℂ) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : inverseAnalysis L (A01.canonicalRoot L) g x = (ZMod.dft.symm (fun r ↦ g ((A01.bandEquiv L).symm r))) x

Bosonize.Ch03.inverse_analysis_left.text: lemma inverse_analysis_left (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (hLK : (L : K) ≠ 0) : (inverseAnalysis L ζ).comp (analysis L ζ) = LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.inverse_analysis_right.text: lemma inverse_analysis_right (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (hLK : (L : K) ≠ 0) : (analysis L ζ).comp (inverseAnalysis L ζ) = LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.inverse_shift_character.text: lemma inverse_shift_character (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Band L) : Ch02.inverseShift (A01.bandCharacter L ζ k) = (ζ ^ (-k.val)) • A01.bandCharacter L ζ k

Bosonize.Ch03.laplacian_character.text: lemma laplacian_character (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Band L) : Ch02.laplacian (A01.bandCharacter L ζ k) = (ζ ^ k.val + ζ ^ (-k.val) - 2) • A01.bandCharacter L ζ k

Bosonize.Ch03.laplacian_eigenvalue_facto.text: lemma laplacian_eigenvalue_factor (ζ : K) (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) (k : ℤ) : (ζ ^ k - 1) * (1 - ζ ^ (-k)) = ζ ^ k + ζ ^ (-k) - 2

Bosonize.Ch03.shift_character.text: lemma shift_character (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) (k : Ch01.Band L) : Ch02.shift (A01.bandCharacter L ζ k) = (ζ ^ k.val) • A01.bandCharacter L ζ k

Bosonize.Ch03.singleton_analysis.text: lemma singleton_analysis (f : Ch01.Lattice 1 → ℂ) (k : Ch01.Band 1) : analysis 1 (A01.canonicalRoot 1) f k = f 0

Bosonize.Ch03.synthesisEuclidean_analysi.text: lemma synthesisEuclidean_analysisEuclidean (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : (synthesisEuclidean L).comp (analysisEuclidean L) = (L : ℂ) • LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.synthesis_analysis.text: lemma synthesis_analysis (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ L) : (synthesis L ζ).comp (analysis L ζ) = (L : K) • LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.synthesis_apply.text: lemma synthesis_apply (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ζ : K) (g : Ch01.Band L → K) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : synthesis L ζ g x = ∑ k : Ch01.Band L, g k * A01.bandCharacter L ζ k x

Bosonize.Ch03.unitary_adjoint.text: lemma unitary_adjoint (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : (unitaryFourier L).adjoint = inverseUnitaryFourier L

Bosonize.Ch03.unitary_inner.text: lemma unitary_inner (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (f g : PositionSpace L) : inner ℂ (unitaryFourier L f) (unitaryFourier L g) = inner ℂ f g

Bosonize.Ch03.unitary_inverse_left.text: lemma unitary_inverse_left (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : (inverseUnitaryFourier L).comp (unitaryFourier L) = LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.unitary_inverse_right.text: lemma unitary_inverse_right (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : (unitaryFourier L).comp (inverseUnitaryFourier L) = LinearMap.id

Bosonize.Ch03.unitary_isometry.text: lemma unitary_isometry (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : Isometry (unitaryFourier L)

Bosonize.Ch03.unitary_laplacian.text: lemma unitary_laplacian (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (f : PositionSpace L) (k : Ch01.Band L) : momentumFunctions L (unitaryFourier L (transportPositionOperator L Ch02.laplacian f)) k = (A01.canonicalRoot L ^ k.val + A01.canonicalRoot L ^ (-k.val) - 2) * momentumFunctions L (unitaryFourier L f) k

Bosonize.Ch03.unitary_surjective.text: lemma unitary_surjective (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] : Function.Surjective (unitaryFourier L)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch04.precedingCount
commands.text: def precedingCount (i : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) : ℕ := (S.filter (· < i)).card

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch04.fermionSign
commands.text: def fermionSign (i : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) : ℂ := (-1 : ℂ) ^ precedingCount i S

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch04.creation
def Bosonize.Ch04.annihilation
commands.text:
noncomputable def annihilation (i : ι) : Module.End ℂ (A02.FockSpace ι) :=
  A02.extendBasis fun S =>
    if i ∈ S then fermionSign i S • A02.ket (S.erase i) else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch04.number
commands.text:
noncomputable def number (i : ι) : Module.End ℂ (A02.FockSpace ι) :=
  creation i * annihilation i

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch04.totalNumber
commands.text: noncomputable def totalNumber : Module.End ℂ (A02.FockSpace ι) := ∑ i : ι, number i

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch04.parity
commands.text:
noncomputable def parity : Module.End ℂ (A02.FockSpace ι) :=
  ((Finset.univ : Finset ι).sort (· ≤ ·)).map
    (fun i => 1 - (2 : ℂ) • number i) |>.prod

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch04.hopping
commands.text:
noncomputable def hopping (i j : ι) : Module.End ℂ (A02.FockSpace ι) :=
  creation i * annihilation j

Bosonize.Ch04.annihilation_car.text: lemma annihilation_car (i j : ι) : A02.anticommutator (annihilation i) (annihilation j) = 0

Bosonize.Ch04.annihilation_eq_adjoint.text: lemma annihilation_eq_adjoint (i : ι) : annihilation i = LinearMap.adjoint (creation i)

Bosonize.Ch04.annihilation_ket.text: lemma annihilation_ket (i : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) : annihilation i (A02.ket S) = if i ∈ S then fermionSign i S • A02.ket (S.erase i) else 0

Bosonize.Ch04.annihilation_singleton.text: lemma annihilation_singleton (i : ι) : annihilation i (A02.ket {i}) = A02.ket ∅

Bosonize.Ch04.annihilation_square.text: lemma annihilation_square (i : ι) : annihilation i * annihilation i = 0

Bosonize.Ch04.bilinear_commutator.text: lemma bilinear_commutator (a b c d : ι) : A02.commutator (hopping a b) (hopping c d) = (if b = c then (1 : ℂ) else 0) • hopping a d - (if a = d then (1 : ℂ) else 0) • hopping c b

Bosonize.Ch04.concrete_car_exists.text: lemma concrete_car_exists : ∃ R : A02.CAR ι (A02.FockSpace ι), R.annihilation = annihilation ∧ R.creation = creation

Bosonize.Ch04.creation_adjoint_pairing.text: lemma creation_adjoint_pairing (i : ι) (S T : A02.Occupation ι) : inner ℂ (A02.ket S) (annihilation i (A02.ket T)) = inner ℂ (creation i (A02.ket S)) (A02.ket T)

Bosonize.Ch04.creation_car.text: lemma creation_car (i j : ι) : A02.anticommutator (creation i) (creation j) = 0

Bosonize.Ch04.creation_eq_adjoint.text: lemma creation_eq_adjoint (i : ι) : creation i = LinearMap.adjoint (annihilation i)

Bosonize.Ch04.creation_ket.text: lemma creation_ket (i : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) : creation i (A02.ket S) = if i ∈ S then 0 else fermionSign i S • A02.ket (insert i S)

Bosonize.Ch04.creation_square.text: lemma creation_square (i : ι) : creation i * creation i = 0

Bosonize.Ch04.creation_vacuum.text: lemma creation_vacuum (i : ι) : creation i (A02.ket ∅) = A02.ket {i}

Bosonize.Ch04.fermion_sign_conj.text: omit [Fintype ι] in lemma fermion_sign_conj (i : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) : conj (fermionSign i S) = fermionSign i S

Bosonize.Ch04.fermion_sign_empty.text: omit [Fintype ι] in lemma fermion_sign_empty (i : ι) : fermionSign i ∅ = 1

Bosonize.Ch04.fermion_sign_erase_self.text: omit [Fintype ι] in lemma fermion_sign_erase_self (i : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) : fermionSign i (S.erase i) = fermionSign i S

Bosonize.Ch04.fermion_sign_insert_self.text: omit [Fintype ι] in lemma fermion_sign_insert_self (i : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) : fermionSign i (insert i S) = fermionSign i S

Bosonize.Ch04.fermion_sign_ne_zero.text: omit [Fintype ι] in lemma fermion_sign_ne_zero (i : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) : fermionSign i S ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch04.fermion_sign_square.text: omit [Fintype ι] in lemma fermion_sign_square (i : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) : fermionSign i S * fermionSign i S = 1

Bosonize.Ch04.hopping_adjoint.text: lemma hopping_adjoint (i j : ι) : LinearMap.adjoint (hopping i j) = hopping j i

Bosonize.Ch04.hopping_blocked.text: lemma hopping_blocked (i j : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) (h : j ∉ S ∨ (i ≠ j ∧ i ∈ S)) : hopping i j (A02.ket S) = 0

Bosonize.Ch04.hopping_diagonal.text: lemma hopping_diagonal (i : ι) : hopping i i = number i

Bosonize.Ch04.hopping_ket.text: lemma hopping_ket (i j : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) (hij : i ≠ j) (hi : i ∉ S) (hj : j ∈ S) : hopping i j (A02.ket S) = (fermionSign j S * fermionSign i (S.erase j)) • A02.ket (insert i (S.erase j))

Bosonize.Ch04.mixed_car.text: lemma mixed_car (i j : ι) : A02.anticommutator (annihilation i) (creation j) = (if i = j then (1 : ℂ) else 0) • (1 : Module.End ℂ (A02.FockSpace ι))

Bosonize.Ch04.number_adjoint.text: lemma number_adjoint (i : ι) : LinearMap.adjoint (number i) = number i

Bosonize.Ch04.number_annihilation_commut.text: lemma number_annihilation_commutator (i j : ι) : A02.commutator (number i) (annihilation j) = -(if i = j then (1 : ℂ) else 0) • annihilation j

Bosonize.Ch04.number_commute.text: lemma number_commute (i j : ι) : number i * number j = number j * number i

Bosonize.Ch04.number_creation_commutator.text: lemma number_creation_commutator (i j : ι) : A02.commutator (number i) (creation j) = (if i = j then (1 : ℂ) else 0) • creation j

Bosonize.Ch04.number_idempotent.text: lemma number_idempotent (i : ι) : number i * number i = number i

Bosonize.Ch04.number_ket.text: lemma number_ket (i : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) : number i (A02.ket S) = (if i ∈ S then (1 : ℂ) else 0) • A02.ket S

Bosonize.Ch04.parity_adjoint.text: lemma parity_adjoint : LinearMap.adjoint (parity (ι := ι)) = parity (ι := ι)

Bosonize.Ch04.parity_annihilation.text: lemma parity_annihilation (i : ι) : parity (ι := ι) * annihilation i = -(annihilation i * parity (ι := ι))

Bosonize.Ch04.parity_creation.text: lemma parity_creation (i : ι) : parity (ι := ι) * creation i = -(creation i * parity (ι := ι))

Bosonize.Ch04.parity_ket.text: lemma parity_ket (S : A02.Occupation ι) : parity (ι := ι) (A02.ket S) = (-1 : ℂ) ^ S.card • A02.ket S

Bosonize.Ch04.parity_square.text: lemma parity_square : parity (ι := ι) * parity (ι := ι) = 1

Bosonize.Ch04.preceding_count_empty.text: omit [Fintype ι] in lemma preceding_count_empty (i : ι) : precedingCount i ∅ = 0

Bosonize.Ch04.preceding_count_erase.text: omit [Fintype ι] in lemma preceding_count_erase (i j : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) (hj : j ∈ S) : precedingCount i S = precedingCount i (S.erase j) + if j < i then 1 else 0

Bosonize.Ch04.preceding_count_erase_self.text: omit [Fintype ι] in lemma preceding_count_erase_self (i : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) : precedingCount i (S.erase i) = precedingCount i S

Bosonize.Ch04.preceding_count_insert.text: omit [Fintype ι] in lemma preceding_count_insert (i j : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) (hj : j ∉ S) : precedingCount i (insert j S) = precedingCount i S + if j < i then 1 else 0

Bosonize.Ch04.preceding_count_insert_sel.text: omit [Fintype ι] in lemma preceding_count_insert_self (i : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) : precedingCount i (insert i S) = precedingCount i S

Bosonize.Ch04.sign_erase_erase.text: omit [Fintype ι] in lemma sign_erase_erase (i j : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) (hij : i ≠ j) (hi : i ∈ S) (hj : j ∈ S) : fermionSign j S * fermionSign i (S.erase j) = -(fermionSign i S * fermionSign j (S.erase i))

Bosonize.Ch04.sign_insert_erase.text: omit [Fintype ι] in lemma sign_insert_erase (i j : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) (hij : i ≠ j) (hi : i ∉ S) (hj : j ∈ S) : fermionSign j S * fermionSign i (S.erase j) = -(fermionSign i S * fermionSign j (insert i S))

Bosonize.Ch04.sign_insert_insert.text: omit [Fintype ι] in lemma sign_insert_insert (i j : ι) (S : A02.Occupation ι) (hij : i ≠ j) (hi : i ∉ S) (hj : j ∉ S) : fermionSign j S * fermionSign i (insert j S) = -(fermionSign i S * fermionSign j (insert i S))

Bosonize.Ch04.total_number_adjoint.text: lemma total_number_adjoint : LinearMap.adjoint (totalNumber (ι := ι)) = totalNumber (ι := ι)

Bosonize.Ch04.total_number_annihilation_.text: lemma total_number_annihilation_commutator (i : ι) : A02.commutator (totalNumber (ι := ι)) (annihilation i) = -annihilation i

Bosonize.Ch04.total_number_creation_comm.text: lemma total_number_creation_commutator (i : ι) : A02.commutator (totalNumber (ι := ι)) (creation i) = creation i

Bosonize.Ch04.total_number_ket.text: lemma total_number_ket (S : A02.Occupation ι) : totalNumber (ι := ι) (A02.ket S) = (S.card : ℂ) • A02.ket S

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.Ch05.Operators
commands.text: abbrev Operators (L : ℕ) := Module.End ℂ (FockSpace L)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch05.momentumAnnihilation
commands.text:
noncomputable def momentumAnnihilation (L : ℕ) (k : Ch01.Band L) : Operators L :=
  Ch04.annihilation k

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch05.momentumCreation
commands.text:
noncomputable def momentumCreation (L : ℕ) (k : Ch01.Band L) : Operators L :=
  Ch04.creation k

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch05.momentumNumber
commands.text:
noncomputable def momentumNumber (L : ℕ) (k : Ch01.Band L) : Operators L :=
  momentumCreation L k * momentumAnnihilation L k

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch05.positionAnnihilation
commands.text:
noncomputable def positionAnnihilation (L : ℕ) [NeZero L]
    (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : Operators L :=
  (A01.normalization L : ℂ) • ∑ k : Ch01.Band L,
    A01.bandCharacter L (A01.canonicalRoot L) k x • momentumAnnihilation L k

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch05.positionCreation
commands.text:
noncomputable def positionCreation (L : ℕ) [NeZero L]
    (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : Operators L :=
  (A01.normalization L : ℂ) • ∑ k : Ch01.Band L,
    A01.integerCharacter (A01.canonicalRoot L) (-k.val) (x.val : ℤ) • momentumCreation L k

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch05.positionNumber
commands.text:
noncomputable def positionNumber (L : ℕ) [NeZero L]
    (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : Operators L :=
  positionCreation L x * positionAnnihilation L x

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch05.totalNumber
commands.text:
noncomputable def totalNumber (L : ℕ) : Operators L :=
  ∑ k : Ch01.Band L, momentumNumber L k

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch05.occupationEnergy
commands.text:
def occupationEnergy (L : ℕ) (S : A02.Occupation (Ch01.Band L)) : ℤ :=
  ∑ k ∈ S, k.val

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch05.bareHamiltonian
commands.text:
noncomputable def bareHamiltonian (L : ℕ) : Operators L :=
  ∑ k : Ch01.Band L, (k.val : ℂ) • momentumNumber L k

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch05.seaConfiguration
commands.text:
def seaConfiguration (L : ℕ) : A02.Occupation (Ch01.Band L) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun k => k.val ≤ 0)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch05.seaEnergy
commands.text: def seaEnergy (L : ℕ) : ℤ := occupationEnergy L (seaConfiguration L)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch05.seaKet
commands.text: noncomputable def seaKet (L : ℕ) : FockSpace L := A02.ket (seaConfiguration L)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch05.shiftedHamiltonian
commands.text:
noncomputable def shiftedHamiltonian (L : ℕ) : Operators L :=
  bareHamiltonian L - (seaEnergy L : ℂ) • (1 : Operators L)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch05.parity
commands.text: noncomputable def parity (L : ℕ) : Operators L := Ch04.parity

Bosonize.Ch05.bare_annihilation_commutat.text: lemma bare_annihilation_commutator (k : Ch01.Band L) : A02.commutator (bareHamiltonian L) (momentumAnnihilation L k) = (-k.val : ℂ) • momentumAnnihilation L k

Bosonize.Ch05.bare_creation_commutator.text: lemma bare_creation_commutator (k : Ch01.Band L) : A02.commutator (bareHamiltonian L) (momentumCreation L k) = (k.val : ℂ) • momentumCreation L k

Bosonize.Ch05.bare_hamiltonian_adjoint.text: lemma bare_hamiltonian_adjoint : LinearMap.adjoint (bareHamiltonian L) = bareHamiltonian L

Bosonize.Ch05.bare_hamiltonian_ket.text: lemma bare_hamiltonian_ket (S : A02.Occupation (Ch01.Band L)) : bareHamiltonian L (A02.ket S) = (occupationEnergy L S : ℂ) • A02.ket S

Bosonize.Ch05.bare_hamiltonian_sea.text: lemma bare_hamiltonian_sea : bareHamiltonian L (seaKet L) = (seaEnergy L : ℂ) • seaKet L

Bosonize.Ch05.inverse_annihilation.text: lemma inverse_annihilation (k : Ch01.Band L) : momentumAnnihilation L k = (A01.normalization L : ℂ) • ∑ x : Ch01.Lattice L, A01.integerCharacter (A01.canonicalRoot L) (-k.val) (x.val : ℤ) • positionAnnihilation L x

Bosonize.Ch05.inverse_creation.text: lemma inverse_creation (k : Ch01.Band L) : momentumCreation L k = (A01.normalization L : ℂ) • ∑ x : Ch01.Lattice L, A01.bandCharacter L (A01.canonicalRoot L) k x • positionCreation L x

Bosonize.Ch05.parity_position_annihilati.text: lemma parity_position_annihilation (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : parity L * positionAnnihilation L x = -(positionAnnihilation L x * parity L)

Bosonize.Ch05.parity_position_creation.text: lemma parity_position_creation (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : parity L * positionCreation L x = -(positionCreation L x * parity L)

Bosonize.Ch05.position_annihilation_car.text: lemma position_annihilation_car (x y : Ch01.Lattice L) : A02.anticommutator (positionAnnihilation L x) (positionAnnihilation L y) = 0

Bosonize.Ch05.position_annihilation_eq_a.text: lemma position_annihilation_eq_adjoint (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : positionAnnihilation L x = LinearMap.adjoint (positionCreation L x)

Bosonize.Ch05.position_annihilation_vacu.text: lemma position_annihilation_vacuum (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : positionAnnihilation L x (A02.ket ∅) = 0

Bosonize.Ch05.position_car_exists.text: lemma position_car_exists : ∃ R : A02.CAR (Ch01.Lattice L) (FockSpace L), R.annihilation = positionAnnihilation L ∧ R.creation = positionCreation L

Bosonize.Ch05.position_creation_car.text: lemma position_creation_car (x y : Ch01.Lattice L) : A02.anticommutator (positionCreation L x) (positionCreation L y) = 0

Bosonize.Ch05.position_creation_eq_adjoi.text: lemma position_creation_eq_adjoint (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : positionCreation L x = LinearMap.adjoint (positionAnnihilation L x)

Bosonize.Ch05.position_creation_vacuum_n.text: lemma position_creation_vacuum_ne_zero (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : positionCreation L x (A02.ket ∅) ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch05.position_mixed_car.text: lemma position_mixed_car (x y : Ch01.Lattice L) : A02.anticommutator (positionAnnihilation L x) (positionCreation L y) = (if x = y then (1 : ℂ) else 0) • (1 : Operators L)

Bosonize.Ch05.position_number_adjoint.text: lemma position_number_adjoint (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : LinearMap.adjoint (positionNumber L x) = positionNumber L x

Bosonize.Ch05.position_number_commute.text: lemma position_number_commute (x y : Ch01.Lattice L) : positionNumber L x * positionNumber L y = positionNumber L y * positionNumber L x

Bosonize.Ch05.position_number_idempotent.text: lemma position_number_idempotent (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : positionNumber L x * positionNumber L x = positionNumber L x

Bosonize.Ch05.sea_energy_even.text: lemma sea_energy_even (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) : seaEnergy (2*h) = -((h : ℤ) * ((h : ℤ) - 1) / 2)

Bosonize.Ch05.shifted_annihilation_commu.text: lemma shifted_annihilation_commutator (k : Ch01.Band L) : A02.commutator (shiftedHamiltonian L) (momentumAnnihilation L k) = (-k.val : ℂ) • momentumAnnihilation L k

Bosonize.Ch05.shifted_creation_commutato.text: lemma shifted_creation_commutator (k : Ch01.Band L) : A02.commutator (shiftedHamiltonian L) (momentumCreation L k) = (k.val : ℂ) • momentumCreation L k

Bosonize.Ch05.shifted_hamiltonian_adjoin.text: lemma shifted_hamiltonian_adjoint : LinearMap.adjoint (shiftedHamiltonian L) = shiftedHamiltonian L

Bosonize.Ch05.shifted_hamiltonian_ket.text: lemma shifted_hamiltonian_ket (S : A02.Occupation (Ch01.Band L)) : shiftedHamiltonian L (A02.ket S) = ((occupationEnergy L S - seaEnergy L : ℤ) : ℂ) • A02.ket S

Bosonize.Ch05.total_number_ket.text: lemma total_number_ket (S : A02.Occupation (Ch01.Band L)) : totalNumber L (A02.ket S) = (S.card : ℂ) • A02.ket S

Bosonize.Ch05.total_number_position.text: lemma total_number_position : (∑ x : Ch01.Lattice L, positionNumber L x) = totalNumber L

Bosonize.Ch05.total_number_position_anni.text: lemma total_number_position_annihilation_commutator (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : A02.commutator (totalNumber L) (positionAnnihilation L x) = -positionAnnihilation L x

Bosonize.Ch05.total_number_position_crea.text: lemma total_number_position_creation_commutator (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : A02.commutator (totalNumber L) (positionCreation L x) = positionCreation L x

commands.label: structure Bosonize.Ch06Ext.BoundaryTwist
commands.text:
structure BoundaryTwist (L : ℕ) where
  step : ℂ
  norm_step : ‖step‖ = 1

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.angleTwist
commands.text:
noncomputable def angleTwist (L : ℕ) (β : ℝ) : BoundaryTwist L :=
  ⟨Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*β/(L : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.I),
    Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I _⟩

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.periodicTwist
commands.text: def periodicTwist (L : ℕ) : BoundaryTwist L := ⟨1, norm_one⟩

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.antiperiodicTwist
commands.text: noncomputable def antiperiodicTwist (L : ℕ) : BoundaryTwist L := angleTwist L (-1/2)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.holonomy
commands.text: def holonomy (L : ℕ) (b : BoundaryTwist L) : ℂ := b.step^L

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.liftPhase
commands.text: noncomputable def liftPhase (L : ℕ) (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) : ℂ := b.step^n

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.sameHolonomy
commands.text: def sameHolonomy (L : ℕ) (b c : BoundaryTwist L) : Prop := holonomy L b = holonomy L c

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.annihilation
commands.text:
noncomputable def annihilation (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) : Ch05.Operators L :=
  liftPhase L b n • Ch05.positionAnnihilation L (n : Ch01.Lattice L)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.creation
commands.text:
noncomputable def creation (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) : Ch05.Operators L :=
  star (liftPhase L b n) • Ch05.positionCreation L (n : Ch01.Lattice L)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.siteAnnihilation
commands.text:
noncomputable def siteAnnihilation (b : BoundaryTwist L) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : Ch05.Operators L :=
  annihilation L b (x.val : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.siteCreation
commands.text:
noncomputable def siteCreation (b : BoundaryTwist L) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : Ch05.Operators L :=
  creation L b (x.val : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.density
commands.text:
noncomputable def density (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) : Ch05.Operators L :=
  creation L b n * annihilation L b n

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.twistedCharacter
commands.text:
noncomputable def twistedCharacter (b : BoundaryTwist L) (k : Ch01.Band L) (n : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  liftPhase L b n * A01.integerCharacter (A01.canonicalRoot L) k.val n

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.localGenerators
commands.text:
noncomputable def localGenerators (b : BoundaryTwist L) (I : Ch06.Region L) : Set (Ch05.Operators L) :=
  {A | ∃ x ∈ I, A = siteAnnihilation L b x ∨ A = siteCreation L b x}

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.localAlgebra
commands.text:
noncomputable def localAlgebra (b : BoundaryTwist L) (I : Ch06.Region L) : Subalgebra ℂ (Ch05.Operators L) :=
  Algebra.adjoin ℂ (localGenerators L b I)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.localPart
commands.text:
noncomputable def localPart (b : BoundaryTwist L) (I : Ch06.Region L) (σ : Ch06.Degree) :
    Submodule ℂ (Ch05.Operators L) :=
  (localAlgebra L b I).toSubmodule ⊓
    LinearMap.ker (Ch06.parityMap L - Ch06.degreeSign σ • LinearMap.id)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.translation
commands.text:
noncomputable def translation (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℤ) : Ch05.Operators L :=
  A02.extendBasis (fun S =>
    (b.step^(-m*(S.card : ℤ)) *
      A01.canonicalRoot L^(-m*Ch05.occupationEnergy L S)) • A02.ket S)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.gauge
commands.text:
noncomputable def gauge (u : ℂ) : Ch05.Operators L :=
  A02.extendBasis (fun S => u^(-(S.card : ℤ)) • A02.ket S)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.transport
commands.text:
noncomputable def transport (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℤ) :
    Ch05.Operators L →ₗ[ℂ] Ch05.Operators L :=
  (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (translation L b (-m))).comp
    (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (translation L b m))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.windingNumber
commands.text: def windingNumber (n : ℤ) : ℤ := n / (L : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.seamPhase
commands.text:
noncomputable def seamPhase (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  holonomy L b ^ windingNumber L n

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.shiftRegion
commands.text:
def shiftRegion (m : ℤ) (I : Ch06.Region L) : Ch06.Region L :=
  (fun x : Ch01.Lattice L => x+(m : Ch01.Lattice L)) '' I

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.zeroMode
commands.text:
noncomputable def zeroMode (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) (referenceCharge : ℤ) : Ch05.Operators L :=
  A02.extendBasis (fun S =>
    (liftPhase L b n * A01.canonicalRoot L^(n*((S.card : ℤ)-referenceCharge))) • A02.ket S)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.jwHolonomy
commands.text: noncomputable def jwHolonomy (particles : ℤ) : ℂ := -((-1 : ℂ)^particles)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.jwSectorTwist
commands.text:
noncomputable def jwSectorTwist (L : ℕ) (particles : ℤ) : BoundaryTwist L :=
  if Even particles then antiperiodicTwist L else periodicTwist L

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.physicalMomentum
commands.text: def physicalMomentum (L : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (k : Ch01.Band L) : ℝ := (k.val : ℝ)+β

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.physicalOccupationEnergy
commands.text:
def physicalOccupationEnergy (L : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (S : Ch06.Occupation L) : ℝ :=
  ∑ k ∈ S, physicalMomentum L β k

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.physicalRelativeEnergy
commands.text:
def physicalRelativeEnergy (L : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (S : Ch06.Occupation L) : ℝ :=
  physicalOccupationEnergy L β S - physicalOccupationEnergy L β (Ch05.seaConfiguration L)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06Ext.physicalGroundEnergy
commands.text: noncomputable def physicalGroundEnergy (β : ℝ) (N : ℤ) : ℝ := (N : ℝ)*((N : ℝ)+1)/2+β*(N : ℝ)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.angle_holonomy.text: lemma angle_holonomy (β : ℝ) : holonomy L (angleTwist L β) = Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*β : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.I)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.angle_integer_holonomy.text: lemma angle_integer_holonomy (β : ℝ) (z : ℤ) : sameHolonomy L (angleTwist L (β+(z : ℝ))) (angleTwist L β)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.angle_root_shift.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma angle_root_shift (β : ℝ) : (angleTwist L (β+1)).step = (angleTwist L β).step * A01.canonicalRoot L

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.angle_twist_surjective.text: lemma angle_twist_surjective (b : BoundaryTwist L) : ∃ β : ℝ, angleTwist L β = b

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.annihilation_fourier.text: lemma annihilation_fourier (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) : annihilation L b n = (A01.normalization L : ℂ) • ∑ k : Ch01.Band L, twistedCharacter L b k n • Ch05.momentumAnnihilation L k

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.annihilation_ne_zero.text: lemma annihilation_ne_zero (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) : annihilation L b n ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.annihilation_winding.text: lemma annihilation_winding (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n w : ℤ) : annihilation L b (n+w*(L : ℤ)) = holonomy L b^w • annihilation L b n

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.antiperiodic_field.text: lemma antiperiodic_field (n : ℤ) : annihilation L (antiperiodicTwist L) (n+(L : ℤ)) = -annihilation L (antiperiodicTwist L) n

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.apbc_full_ring_parity.text: lemma apbc_full_ring_parity : translation L (antiperiodicTwist L) (L : ℤ) = Ch06.parityOperator L

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.apbc_ground_energy.text: lemma apbc_ground_energy (N : ℤ) : physicalGroundEnergy (-1/2) N = (N : ℝ)^2/2

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.change_trivialization_f.text: lemma change_trivialization_field (b c : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) : annihilation L c n = (c.step/b.step)^n • annihilation L b n

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.creation_adjoint.text: lemma creation_adjoint (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) : creation L b n = LinearMap.adjoint (annihilation L b n)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.creation_winding.text: lemma creation_winding (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n w : ℤ) : creation L b (n+w*(L : ℤ)) = star (holonomy L b^w) • creation L b n

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.density_periodic.text: lemma density_periodic (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) : density L b (n+(L : ℤ)) = density L b n

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.density_untwisted.text: lemma density_untwisted (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) : density L b n = Ch05.positionNumber L (n : Ch01.Lattice L)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.excitation_twist_cancel.text: lemma excitation_twist_cancel (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (β : ℝ) (S : Ch06.Occupation (2*h)) : physicalRelativeEnergy (2*h) β S-physicalGroundEnergy β ((S.card : ℤ)-(h : ℤ)) = ((Ch05.occupationEnergy (2*h) S-Ch05.seaEnergy (2*h) : ℤ) : ℝ)- physicalGroundEnergy 0 ((S.card : ℤ)-(h : ℤ))

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.full_ring_translation.text: lemma full_ring_translation (b : BoundaryTwist L) : translation L b (L : ℤ) = gauge L (holonomy L b)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.graded_locality.text: lemma graded_locality (b : BoundaryTwist L) (I J : Ch06.Region L) (hIJ : Disjoint I J) (σ τ : Ch06.Degree) (A B : Ch05.Operators L) (hA : A ∈ localPart L b I σ) (hB : B ∈ localPart L b J τ) : A*B = (-1 : ℂ)^(σ.val*τ.val) • (B*A)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.holonomy_acts_on_field.text: lemma holonomy_acts_on_field (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) : transport L b (L : ℤ) (annihilation L b n) = holonomy L b • annihilation L b n

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.holonomy_detected_iff.text: lemma holonomy_detected_iff (b c : BoundaryTwist L) : (∀ n : ℤ, transport L b (L : ℤ) (annihilation L b n) = holonomy L c • annihilation L b n) ↔ sameHolonomy L b c

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.holonomy_norm.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma holonomy_norm (b : BoundaryTwist L) : ‖holonomy L b‖ = 1

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.holonomy_surjective.text: lemma holonomy_surjective (u : ℂ) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) : ∃ b : BoundaryTwist L, holonomy L b = u

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.jw_even.text: lemma jw_even (particles : ℤ) (hp : Even particles) : jwHolonomy particles = -1

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.jw_odd.text: lemma jw_odd (particles : ℤ) (hp : Odd particles) : jwHolonomy particles = 1

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.jw_sector_holonomy.text: lemma jw_sector_holonomy (L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (particles : ℤ) : holonomy L (jwSectorTwist L particles) = jwHolonomy particles

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.lift_phase_add.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma lift_phase_add (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n m : ℤ) : liftPhase L b (n+m) = liftPhase L b n * liftPhase L b m

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.lift_phase_norm.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma lift_phase_norm (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) : ‖liftPhase L b n‖ = 1

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.lift_phase_winding.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma lift_phase_winding (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n w : ℤ) : liftPhase L b (n+w*(L : ℤ)) = holonomy L b^w * liftPhase L b n

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.lift_site_relation.text: lemma lift_site_relation (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n : ℤ) : annihilation L b n = seamPhase L b n • siteAnnihilation L b (n : Ch01.Lattice L)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.lifted_mixed_car.text: lemma lifted_mixed_car (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n m : ℤ) : A02.anticommutator (annihilation L b n) (creation L b m) = (if (n : Ch01.Lattice L)=(m : Ch01.Lattice L) then liftPhase L b (n-m) else 0) • (1 : Ch05.Operators L)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.local_algebra_eq.text: lemma local_algebra_eq (b : BoundaryTwist L) (I : Ch06.Region L) : localAlgebra L b I = Ch06.localAlgebra L I

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.local_part_eq.text: lemma local_part_eq (b : BoundaryTwist L) (I : Ch06.Region L) (σ : Ch06.Degree) : localPart L b I σ = Ch06.localPart L I σ

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.local_part_transport.text: lemma local_part_transport (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℤ) (I : Ch06.Region L) (σ : Ch06.Degree) : ∀ A, A ∈ localPart L b I σ ↔ transport L b m A ∈ localPart L b (shiftRegion L m I) σ

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.local_transport.text: lemma local_transport (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℤ) (I : Ch06.Region L) : ∀ A, A ∈ localAlgebra L b I ↔ transport L b m A ∈ localAlgebra L b (shiftRegion L m I)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.periodic_field.text: lemma periodic_field (n : ℤ) : annihilation L (periodicTwist L) n = Ch05.positionAnnihilation L (n : Ch01.Lattice L)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.periodic_holonomy.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma periodic_holonomy : holonomy L (periodicTwist L) = 1

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.physical_energy_shift.text: lemma physical_energy_shift (L : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (S : Ch06.Occupation L) : physicalOccupationEnergy L β S = (Ch05.occupationEnergy L S : ℝ)+β*(S.card : ℝ)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.physical_relative_shift.text: lemma physical_relative_shift (L : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (S : Ch06.Occupation L) : physicalRelativeEnergy L β S = ((Ch05.occupationEnergy L S-Ch05.seaEnergy L : ℤ) : ℝ)+ β*((S.card : ℝ)-((Ch05.seaConfiguration L).card : ℝ))

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.quotient_descent_iff.text: lemma quotient_descent_iff (b : BoundaryTwist L) : (∃ f : Ch01.Lattice L → Ch05.Operators L, ∀ n : ℤ, annihilation L b n = f (n : Ch01.Lattice L)) ↔ holonomy L b = 1

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.seam_phase_winding.text: lemma seam_phase_winding (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n w : ℤ) : seamPhase L b (n+w*(L : ℤ)) = holonomy L b^w*seamPhase L b n

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.seam_transport.text: lemma seam_transport (b : BoundaryTwist L) : transport L b 1 (annihilation L b ((L : ℤ)-1)) = holonomy L b • annihilation L b 0

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.site_annihilation_car.text: lemma site_annihilation_car (b : BoundaryTwist L) (x y : Ch01.Lattice L) : A02.anticommutator (siteAnnihilation L b x) (siteAnnihilation L b y) = 0

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.site_creation_car.text: lemma site_creation_car (b : BoundaryTwist L) (x y : Ch01.Lattice L) : A02.anticommutator (siteCreation L b x) (siteCreation L b y) = 0

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.site_mixed_car.text: lemma site_mixed_car (b : BoundaryTwist L) (x y : Ch01.Lattice L) : A02.anticommutator (siteAnnihilation L b x) (siteCreation L b y) = (if x=y then (1 : ℂ) else 0) • (1 : Ch05.Operators L)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.site_transport.text: lemma site_transport (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℤ) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : transport L b m (siteAnnihilation L b x) = seamPhase L b ((x.val : ℤ)+m) • siteAnnihilation L b (x+(m : Ch01.Lattice L))

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.translation_add.text: lemma translation_add (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m n : ℤ) : translation L b (m+n) = translation L b m * translation L b n

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.translation_adjoint.text: lemma translation_adjoint (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℤ) : LinearMap.adjoint (translation L b m) = translation L b (-m)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.translation_ket.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma translation_ket (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℤ) (S : Ch06.Occupation L) : translation L b m (A02.ket S) = (b.step^(-m*(S.card : ℤ))*A01.canonicalRoot L^(-m*Ch05.occupationEnergy L S)) • A02.ket S

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.translation_power.text: lemma translation_power (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℕ) : translation L b (m : ℤ) = translation L b 1 ^ m

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.translation_preserves_h.text: lemma translation_preserves_hamiltonian (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℤ) : transport L b m (Ch05.bareHamiltonian L) = Ch05.bareHamiltonian L

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.translation_preserves_n.text: lemma translation_preserves_number (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℤ) : transport L b m (Ch05.totalNumber L) = Ch05.totalNumber L

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.translation_preserves_p.text: lemma translation_preserves_parity (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℤ) : transport L b m (Ch06.parityOperator L) = Ch06.parityOperator L

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.translation_unitary.text: lemma translation_unitary (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℤ) : translation L b m * LinearMap.adjoint (translation L b m) = 1 ∧ LinearMap.adjoint (translation L b m) * translation L b m = 1

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.translation_zero.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma translation_zero (b : BoundaryTwist L) : translation L b 0 = 1

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.transport_add.text: lemma transport_add (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m n : ℤ) (A : Ch05.Operators L) : transport L b (m+n) A = transport L b m (transport L b n A)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.transport_annihilation.text: lemma transport_annihilation (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m n : ℤ) : transport L b m (annihilation L b n) = annihilation L b (n+m)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.transport_apply.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma transport_apply (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℤ) (A : Ch05.Operators L) : transport L b m A = translation L b m*A*translation L b (-m)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.transport_automorphism_.text: lemma transport_automorphism_exists (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℤ) : ∃ f : Ch05.Operators L ≃ₐ[ℂ] Ch05.Operators L, (∀ A, f A = transport L b m A) ∧ ∀ A, f (LinearMap.adjoint A) = LinearMap.adjoint (f A)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.transport_creation.text: lemma transport_creation (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m n : ℤ) : transport L b m (creation L b n) = creation L b (n+m)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.transport_star.text: lemma transport_star (b : BoundaryTwist L) (m : ℤ) (A : Ch05.Operators L) : transport L b m (LinearMap.adjoint A) = LinearMap.adjoint (transport L b m A)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.trivialization_ratio_pe.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma trivialization_ratio_periodic (b c : BoundaryTwist L) (hbc : sameHolonomy L b c) (n : ℤ) : (c.step/b.step)^(n+(L : ℤ)) = (c.step/b.step)^n

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.twist_step_ne_zero.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma twist_step_ne_zero (b : BoundaryTwist L) : b.step ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.twisted_character_ortho.text: lemma twisted_character_orthogonality (b : BoundaryTwist L) (k p : Ch01.Band L) : (∑ x : Ch01.Lattice L, star (twistedCharacter L b k (x.val : ℤ))*twistedCharacter L b p (x.val : ℤ)) = if k=p then (L : ℂ) else 0

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.twisted_fourier_inverse.text: lemma twisted_fourier_inverse (b : BoundaryTwist L) (k : Ch01.Band L) : Ch05.momentumAnnihilation L k = (A01.normalization L : ℂ) • ∑ x : Ch01.Lattice L, star (twistedCharacter L b k (x.val : ℤ)) • siteAnnihilation L b x

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.winding_decomposition.text: lemma winding_decomposition (n : ℤ) : n = (((n : Ch01.Lattice L).val : ℕ) : ℤ)+windingNumber L n*(L : ℤ)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.zero_mode_annihilation_.text: lemma zero_mode_annihilation_order (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n referenceCharge : ℤ) (k : Ch01.Band L) : zeroMode L b n referenceCharge*Ch05.momentumAnnihilation L k = A01.canonicalRoot L^(-n) • (Ch05.momentumAnnihilation L k*zeroMode L b n referenceCharge)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.zero_mode_creation_orde.text: lemma zero_mode_creation_order (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n referenceCharge : ℤ) (k : Ch01.Band L) : zeroMode L b n referenceCharge*Ch05.momentumCreation L k = A01.canonicalRoot L^n • (Ch05.momentumCreation L k*zeroMode L b n referenceCharge)

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.zero_mode_ket.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma zero_mode_ket (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n referenceCharge : ℤ) (S : Ch06.Occupation L) : zeroMode L b n referenceCharge (A02.ket S) = (liftPhase L b n*A01.canonicalRoot L^(n*((S.card : ℤ)-referenceCharge))) • A02.ket S

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.zero_mode_unitary.text: lemma zero_mode_unitary (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n referenceCharge : ℤ) : LinearMap.adjoint (zeroMode L b n referenceCharge)*zeroMode L b n referenceCharge = 1

Bosonize.Ch06Ext.zero_mode_winding.text: lemma zero_mode_winding (b : BoundaryTwist L) (n referenceCharge w : ℤ) : zeroMode L b (n+w*(L : ℤ)) referenceCharge = holonomy L b^w • zeroMode L b n referenceCharge

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.Ch06.Letter
commands.text: abbrev Letter (L : ℕ) := Ch01.Lattice L × Bool

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.localGenerators
commands.text:
def localGenerators (I : Region L) : Set (Operators L) :=
  {A | ∃ x ∈ I, A = Ch05.positionAnnihilation L x ∨ A = Ch05.positionCreation L x}

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.localAlgebra
commands.text:
noncomputable def localAlgebra (I : Region L) : Subalgebra ℂ (Operators L) :=
  Algebra.adjoin ℂ (localGenerators L I)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.parityOperator
commands.text: noncomputable def parityOperator : Operators L := Ch04.parity (ι := Ch01.Band L)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.parityMap
commands.text:
noncomputable def parityMap : Operators L →ₗ[ℂ] Operators L :=
  (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (parityOperator L)).comp (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (parityOperator L))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.degreeSign
commands.text: def degreeSign (σ : Degree) : ℂ := (-1 : ℂ) ^ σ.val

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.localPart
commands.text:
noncomputable def localPart (I : Region L) (σ : Degree) : Submodule ℂ (Operators L) :=
  (localAlgebra L I).toSubmodule ⊓
    LinearMap.ker (parityMap L - degreeSign σ • LinearMap.id)

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.Ch06.evenPart
commands.text:
noncomputable abbrev evenPart (I : Region L) : Submodule ℂ (Operators L) :=
  localPart L I 0

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.Ch06.oddPart
commands.text:
noncomputable abbrev oddPart (I : Region L) : Submodule ℂ (Operators L) :=
  localPart L I 1

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.evenProjection
commands.text:
noncomputable def evenProjection : Operators L →ₗ[ℂ] Operators L :=
  (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (LinearMap.id + parityMap L)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.oddProjection
commands.text:
noncomputable def oddProjection : Operators L →ₗ[ℂ] Operators L :=
  (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (LinearMap.id - parityMap L)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.letterOperator
commands.text:
noncomputable def letterOperator (a : Letter L) : Operators L :=
  if a.2 then Ch05.positionCreation L a.1 else Ch05.positionAnnihilation L a.1

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.wordOperator
commands.text:
noncomputable def wordOperator (w : List (Letter L)) : Operators L :=
  (w.map (letterOperator L)).prod

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.supportedWord
commands.text:
def supportedWord (I : Region L) (w : List (Letter L)) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ w, a.1 ∈ I

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.homogeneousWordSpan
commands.text:
noncomputable def homogeneousWordSpan (I : Region L) (σ : Degree) :
    Submodule ℂ (Operators L) :=
  Submodule.span ℂ {A | ∃ w : List (Letter L), supportedWord L I w ∧
    w.length % 2 = σ.val ∧ A = wordOperator L w}

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.creatorWord
commands.text:
noncomputable def creatorWord (S : Occupation L) : Operators L :=
  (((S.sort (· ≤ ·)).reverse).map (Ch05.momentumCreation L)).prod

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.annihilatorWord
commands.text:
noncomputable def annihilatorWord (S : Occupation L) : Operators L :=
  ((S.sort (· ≤ ·)).map (Ch05.momentumAnnihilation L)).prod

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.creatorSign
commands.text:
def creatorSign (S : Occupation L) : ℂ :=
  (-1 : ℂ) ^ (S.card * (S.card - 1) / 2)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.vacuumProjector
commands.text:
noncomputable def vacuumProjector : Operators L :=
  (((Finset.univ : Finset (Ch01.Band L)).sort (· ≤ ·)).map
    (fun k => 1 - Ch04.number k)).prod

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.matrixUnit
commands.text:
noncomputable def matrixUnit (S T : Occupation L) : Operators L :=
  A02.extendBasis fun U => if U = T then A02.ket S else 0

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch06.orderedMatrixUnit
commands.text:
noncomputable def orderedMatrixUnit (S T : Occupation L) : Operators L :=
  (creatorSign L S * creatorSign L T) •
    (creatorWord L S * vacuumProjector L * annihilatorWord L T)

Bosonize.Ch06.annihilation_mem_local.text: lemma annihilation_mem_local (I : Region L) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) (hx : x ∈ I) : Ch05.positionAnnihilation L x ∈ localAlgebra L I

Bosonize.Ch06.annihilation_nonzero.text: lemma annihilation_nonzero (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : Ch05.positionAnnihilation L x ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch06.annihilator_word_adjoint.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma annihilator_word_adjoint (S : Occupation L) : annihilatorWord L S = LinearMap.adjoint (creatorWord L S)

Bosonize.Ch06.creation_mem_local.text: lemma creation_mem_local (I : Region L) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) (hx : x ∈ I) : Ch05.positionCreation L x ∈ localAlgebra L I

Bosonize.Ch06.creator_sign_square.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma creator_sign_square (S : Occupation L) : creatorSign L S * creatorSign L S = 1

Bosonize.Ch06.creator_word_vacuum.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma creator_word_vacuum (S : Occupation L) : creatorWord L S (A02.ket ∅) = creatorSign L S • A02.ket S

Bosonize.Ch06.disjoint_word_swap.text: lemma disjoint_word_swap (I J : Region L) (hIJ : Disjoint I J) (u v : List (Letter L)) (hu : supportedWord L I u) (hv : supportedWord L J v) : wordOperator L u * wordOperator L v = (-1 : ℂ) ^ (u.length * v.length) • (wordOperator L v * wordOperator L u)

Bosonize.Ch06.even_locality.text: lemma even_locality (I J : Region L) (hIJ : Disjoint I J) (A B : Operators L) (hA : A ∈ evenPart L I) (hB : B ∈ evenPart L J) : A02.commutator A B = 0

Bosonize.Ch06.even_projection_idempotent.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma even_projection_idempotent (A : Operators L) : evenProjection L (evenProjection L A) = evenProjection L A

Bosonize.Ch06.even_projection_mem.text: lemma even_projection_mem (I : Region L) (A : Operators L) (hA : A ∈ localAlgebra L I) : evenProjection L A ∈ evenPart L I

Bosonize.Ch06.even_subalgebra_exists.text: lemma even_subalgebra_exists (I : Region L) : ∃ E : Subalgebra ℂ (Operators L), E.toSubmodule = evenPart L I

Bosonize.Ch06.graded_mul.text: lemma graded_mul (I : Region L) (σ τ : Degree) (A B : Operators L) (hA : A ∈ localPart L I σ) (hB : B ∈ localPart L I τ) : A * B ∈ localPart L I (σ + τ)

Bosonize.Ch06.graded_star.text: lemma graded_star (I : Region L) (σ : Degree) (A : Operators L) (hA : A ∈ localPart L I σ) : star A ∈ localPart L I σ

Bosonize.Ch06.local_algebra_empty_scalar.text: lemma local_algebra_empty_scalar (A : Operators L) : A ∈ localAlgebra L ∅ ↔ ∃ z : ℂ, A = z • (1 : Operators L)

Bosonize.Ch06.local_algebra_mono.text: lemma local_algebra_mono (I J : Region L) (hIJ : I ⊆ J) : localAlgebra L I ≤ localAlgebra L J

Bosonize.Ch06.local_algebra_star_closed.text: lemma local_algebra_star_closed (I : Region L) (A : Operators L) (hA : A ∈ localAlgebra L I) : star A ∈ localAlgebra L I

Bosonize.Ch06.local_algebra_union.text: lemma local_algebra_union (I J : Region L) : localAlgebra L (I ∪ J) = localAlgebra L I ⊔ localAlgebra L J

Bosonize.Ch06.local_even_proper.text: lemma local_even_proper (I : Region L) (hI : I.Nonempty) : evenPart L I < (localAlgebra L I).toSubmodule

Bosonize.Ch06.local_grading_disjoint.text: lemma local_grading_disjoint (I : Region L) : Disjoint (evenPart L I) (oddPart L I)

Bosonize.Ch06.local_grading_sup.text: lemma local_grading_sup (I : Region L) : evenPart L I ⊔ oddPart L I = (localAlgebra L I).toSubmodule

Bosonize.Ch06.local_odd_witness.text: lemma local_odd_witness (I : Region L) (x : Ch01.Lattice L) (hx : x ∈ I) : Ch05.positionAnnihilation L x ∈ oddPart L I ∧ Ch05.positionAnnihilation L x ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch06.local_parity_automorphism_.text: lemma local_parity_automorphism_exists (I : Region L) : ∃ α : localAlgebra L I ≃ₐ[ℂ] localAlgebra L I, ∀ A, (α A : Operators L) = parityMap L (A : Operators L)

Bosonize.Ch06.local_part_eq_word_span.text: lemma local_part_eq_word_span (I : Region L) (σ : Degree) : localPart L I σ = homogeneousWordSpan L I σ

Bosonize.Ch06.matrix_unit_expansion.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma matrix_unit_expansion (A : Operators L) : A = ∑ S : Occupation L, ∑ T : Occupation L, (A (A02.ket T)) S • matrixUnit L S T

Bosonize.Ch06.matrix_unit_ket.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma matrix_unit_ket (S T U : Occupation L) : matrixUnit L S T (A02.ket U) = if U = T then A02.ket S else 0

Bosonize.Ch06.matrix_unit_mem_global.text: lemma matrix_unit_mem_global (S T : Occupation L) : matrixUnit L S T ∈ localAlgebra L Set.univ

Bosonize.Ch06.mem_local_part.text: lemma mem_local_part (I : Region L) (σ : Degree) (A : Operators L) : A ∈ localPart L I σ ↔ A ∈ localAlgebra L I ∧ parityMap L A = degreeSign σ • A

Bosonize.Ch06.mixed_projections_zero.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma mixed_projections_zero (A : Operators L) : evenProjection L (oddProjection L A) = 0 ∧ oddProjection L (evenProjection L A) = 0

Bosonize.Ch06.momentum_annihilation_mem_.text: lemma momentum_annihilation_mem_global (k : Ch01.Band L) : Ch05.momentumAnnihilation L k ∈ localAlgebra L Set.univ

Bosonize.Ch06.momentum_creation_mem_glob.text: lemma momentum_creation_mem_global (k : Ch01.Band L) : Ch05.momentumCreation L k ∈ localAlgebra L Set.univ

Bosonize.Ch06.odd_projection_idempotent.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma odd_projection_idempotent (A : Operators L) : oddProjection L (oddProjection L A) = oddProjection L A

Bosonize.Ch06.odd_projection_mem.text: lemma odd_projection_mem (I : Region L) (A : Operators L) (hA : A ∈ localAlgebra L I) : oddProjection L A ∈ oddPart L I

Bosonize.Ch06.operator_star_eq_adjoint.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma operator_star_eq_adjoint (A : Operators L) : star A = LinearMap.adjoint A

Bosonize.Ch06.ordered_matrix_unit_eq.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma ordered_matrix_unit_eq (S T : Occupation L) : orderedMatrixUnit L S T = matrixUnit L S T

Bosonize.Ch06.parity_annihilation.text: lemma parity_annihilation (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : parityMap L (Ch05.positionAnnihilation L x) = -Ch05.positionAnnihilation L x

Bosonize.Ch06.parity_automorphism_exists.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma parity_automorphism_exists : ∃ α : Operators L ≃ₐ[ℂ] Operators L, (∀ A, α A = parityMap L A) ∧ ∀ A, α (star A) = star (α A)

Bosonize.Ch06.parity_creation.text: lemma parity_creation (x : Ch01.Lattice L) : parityMap L (Ch05.positionCreation L x) = -Ch05.positionCreation L x

Bosonize.Ch06.parity_map_apply.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma parity_map_apply (A : Operators L) : parityMap L A = parityOperator L * A * parityOperator L

Bosonize.Ch06.parity_map_involutive.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma parity_map_involutive (A : Operators L) : parityMap L (parityMap L A) = A

Bosonize.Ch06.parity_map_mul.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma parity_map_mul (A B : Operators L) : parityMap L (A * B) = parityMap L A * parityMap L B

Bosonize.Ch06.parity_map_one.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma parity_map_one : parityMap L 1 = 1

Bosonize.Ch06.parity_map_star.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma parity_map_star (A : Operators L) : parityMap L (star A) = star (parityMap L A)

Bosonize.Ch06.parity_preserves_local.text: lemma parity_preserves_local (I : Region L) (A : Operators L) (hA : A ∈ localAlgebra L I) : parityMap L A ∈ localAlgebra L I

Bosonize.Ch06.projection_decomposition.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma projection_decomposition (A : Operators L) : evenProjection L A + oddProjection L A = A

Bosonize.Ch06.twisted_locality.text: lemma twisted_locality (I J : Region L) (hIJ : Disjoint I J) (σ τ : Degree) (A B : Operators L) (hA : A ∈ localPart L I σ) (hB : B ∈ localPart L J τ) : A * B = (-1 : ℂ) ^ (σ.val * τ.val) • (B * A)

Bosonize.Ch06.vacuum_projector_idempoten.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma vacuum_projector_idempotent : vacuumProjector L * vacuumProjector L = vacuumProjector L

Bosonize.Ch06.vacuum_projector_ket.text: omit [NeZero L] in lemma vacuum_projector_ket (S : Occupation L) : vacuumProjector L (A02.ket S) = if S = ∅ then A02.ket ∅ else 0

Bosonize.Ch06.vacuum_projector_mem_globa.text: lemma vacuum_projector_mem_global : vacuumProjector L ∈ localAlgebra L Set.univ

Bosonize.Ch06.word_homogeneous.text: lemma word_homogeneous (w : List (Letter L)) : parityMap L (wordOperator L w) = (-1 : ℂ) ^ w.length • wordOperator L w

Bosonize.Ch06.word_mem_local.text: lemma word_mem_local (I : Region L) (w : List (Letter L)) (hw : supportedWord L I w) : wordOperator L w ∈ localAlgebra L I

commands.label: abbrev Bosonize.Ch07.Operators
commands.text: abbrev Operators (h : ℕ) := Module.End ℂ (FockSpace h)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.admissible
commands.text: def admissible (h : ℕ) (N : ℤ) : Prop := -(h : ℤ) ≤ N ∧ N ≤ (h : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.relativeCharge
commands.text: def relativeCharge (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) : ℤ := (S.card : ℤ)-(h : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.relativeEnergy
commands.text:
def relativeEnergy (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) : ℤ :=
  Ch05.occupationEnergy (2*h) S - Ch05.seaEnergy (2*h)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.excitationEnergy
commands.text:
def excitationEnergy (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) : ℤ :=
  relativeEnergy h S - groundEnergy (relativeCharge h S)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.excitationNat
commands.text: def excitationNat (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) : ℕ := (excitationEnergy h S).toNat

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.groundConfiguration
commands.text:
def groundConfiguration (h : ℕ) (N : ℤ) : Occupation h :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun k => k.val ≤ N)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.groundKet
commands.text:
noncomputable def groundKet (h : ℕ) (N : ℤ) (_hN : admissible h N) : FockSpace h :=
  A02.ket (groundConfiguration h N)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.vacuumKet
commands.text: noncomputable def vacuumKet (h : ℕ) : FockSpace h := Ch05.seaKet (2*h)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.sortedMode
commands.text:
noncomputable def sortedMode (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) : Fin S.card → Ch01.Band (2*h) :=
  S.orderEmbOfFin rfl

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.referenceMode
commands.text:
def referenceMode (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) (i : Fin S.card) : ℤ :=
  -(h : ℤ)+1+(i.val : ℤ)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.displacement
commands.text:
noncomputable def displacement (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) (i : Fin S.card) : ℤ :=
  (sortedMode h S i).val - referenceMode h S i

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.chargeObservable
commands.text:
noncomputable def chargeObservable (h : ℕ) : Operators h :=
  A03.diagonal (fun S => (relativeCharge h S : ℂ))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.excitationObservable
commands.text:
noncomputable def excitationObservable (h : ℕ) : Operators h :=
  A03.diagonal (fun S => (excitationEnergy h S : ℂ))

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.energySpace
commands.text:
noncomputable def energySpace (h : ℕ) (N E : ℤ) : Submodule ℂ (FockSpace h) :=
  A03.fixedEnergy (relativeCharge h) (excitationEnergy h) N E

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.fixedBudget
commands.text:
noncomputable def fixedBudget (h : ℕ) (N K : ℤ) : Submodule ℂ (FockSpace h) :=
  A03.budget (relativeCharge h) (excitationEnergy h) N K

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.boxBudget
commands.text:
noncomputable def boxBudget (h : ℕ) (K : ℤ) (Nmax : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ (FockSpace h) :=
  A03.chargeBox (relativeCharge h) (excitationEnergy h) K Nmax

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.fixedProjection
commands.text:
noncomputable def fixedProjection (h : ℕ) (N K : ℤ) : Operators h :=
  A03.budgetProjection (relativeCharge h) (excitationEnergy h) N K

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.boxProjection
commands.text:
noncomputable def boxProjection (h : ℕ) (K : ℤ) (Nmax : ℕ) : Operators h :=
  A03.boxProjection (relativeCharge h) (excitationEnergy h) K Nmax

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.compressed
commands.text:
noncomputable def compressed (h : ℕ) (N K : ℤ) (A : Operators h) : Operators h :=
  fixedProjection h N K * A * fixedProjection h N K

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.speciesConfiguration
commands.text:
def speciesConfiguration (h : ℕ) (S : A02.Occupation (σ × Ch01.Band (2*h))) (ν : σ) : Occupation h :=
  (S.filter (fun p => p.1 = ν)).image Prod.snd

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.totalExcitation
commands.text:
def totalExcitation (h : ℕ) (S : A02.Occupation (σ × Ch01.Band (2*h))) : ℤ :=
  ∑ ν : σ, excitationEnergy h (speciesConfiguration h S ν)

commands.label: def Bosonize.Ch07.speciesBudget
commands.text:
noncomputable def speciesBudget (h : ℕ) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℤ) :
    Submodule ℂ (A02.FockSpace (σ × Ch01.Band (2*h))) :=
  A03.coordinateSpace {S | (∀ ν, relativeCharge h (speciesConfiguration h S ν) = Ns ν) ∧
    totalExcitation h S ≤ K}

Bosonize.Ch07.active_window_in_band.text: lemma active_window_in_band (h M K Nmax : ℕ) (N j : ℤ) (hN : |N| ≤ (Nmax : ℤ)) (hmargin : A03.uniformCutoff h M K Nmax) (hj : N-(K : ℤ)-(M : ℤ)+1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ N+(K : ℤ)+(M : ℤ)) : Ch01.inBandPredicate (2*h) j

Bosonize.Ch07.annihilation_budget_map.text: lemma annihilation_budget_map (h : ℕ) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) (N K : ℤ) : ∀ v ∈ fixedBudget h N K, Ch05.momentumAnnihilation (2*h) k v ∈ fixedBudget h (N-1) (K-k.val+N)

Bosonize.Ch07.box_projection_adjoint.text: lemma box_projection_adjoint (h : ℕ) (K : ℤ) (Nmax : ℕ) : LinearMap.adjoint (boxProjection h K Nmax) = boxProjection h K Nmax

Bosonize.Ch07.box_projection_idempotent.text: lemma box_projection_idempotent (h : ℕ) (K : ℤ) (Nmax : ℕ) : boxProjection h K Nmax * boxProjection h K Nmax = boxProjection h K Nmax

Bosonize.Ch07.box_projection_range.text: lemma box_projection_range (h : ℕ) (K : ℤ) (Nmax : ℕ) : LinearMap.range (boxProjection h K Nmax) = boxBudget h K Nmax

Bosonize.Ch07.budget_dimension_ge_two.text: lemma budget_dimension_ge_two (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : -(h : ℤ) < N ∧ N < (h : ℤ)) (K : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℂ (fixedBudget h N K)

Bosonize.Ch07.charge_admissible.text: lemma charge_admissible (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) : admissible h (relativeCharge h S)

Bosonize.Ch07.charge_erase.text: lemma charge_erase (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) (hk : k ∈ S) : relativeCharge h (S.erase k) = relativeCharge h S-1

Bosonize.Ch07.charge_insert.text: lemma charge_insert (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) (hk : k ∉ S) : relativeCharge h (insert k S) = relativeCharge h S+1

Bosonize.Ch07.charge_observable_adjoint.text: lemma charge_observable_adjoint (h : ℕ) : LinearMap.adjoint (chargeObservable h) = chargeObservable h

Bosonize.Ch07.charge_observable_ket.text: lemma charge_observable_ket (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) : chargeObservable h (A02.ket S) = (relativeCharge h S : ℂ) • A02.ket S

Bosonize.Ch07.charge_observable_total_nu.text: lemma charge_observable_total_number (h : ℕ) : chargeObservable h = Ch05.totalNumber (2*h) - (h : ℂ) • (1 : Operators h)

Bosonize.Ch07.charge_preserving_budget_m.text: lemma charge_preserving_budget_map (h : ℕ) (A : Operators h) (d N K : ℤ) (hA : A03.Filtered (relativeCharge h) (excitationEnergy h) A 0 d) : ∀ v ∈ fixedBudget h N K, A v ∈ fixedBudget h N (K+d)

Bosonize.Ch07.creation_budget_map.text: lemma creation_budget_map (h : ℕ) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) (N K : ℤ) : ∀ v ∈ fixedBudget h N K, Ch05.momentumCreation (2*h) k v ∈ fixedBudget h (N+1) (K+k.val-(N+1))

Bosonize.Ch07.displacement_le_budget.text: lemma displacement_le_budget (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (S : Occupation h) (K : ℕ) (he : excitationEnergy h S ≤ (K : ℤ)) (i : Fin S.card) : displacement h S i ≤ (K : ℤ)

Bosonize.Ch07.displacement_mono.text: lemma displacement_mono (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) : Monotone (displacement h S)

Bosonize.Ch07.displacement_nonneg.text: lemma displacement_nonneg (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) (i : Fin S.card) : 0 ≤ displacement h S i

Bosonize.Ch07.energy_sorted_sum.text: lemma energy_sorted_sum (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) : Ch05.occupationEnergy (2*h) S = ∑ i : Fin S.card, (sortedMode h S i).val

Bosonize.Ch07.excitation_displacement_su.text: lemma excitation_displacement_sum (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (S : Occupation h) : excitationEnergy h S = ∑ i : Fin S.card, displacement h S i

Bosonize.Ch07.excitation_erase.text: lemma excitation_erase (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) (hk : k ∈ S) : excitationEnergy h (S.erase k) = excitationEnergy h S-k.val+relativeCharge h S

Bosonize.Ch07.excitation_insert.text: lemma excitation_insert (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) (hk : k ∉ S) : excitationEnergy h (insert k S) = excitationEnergy h S+k.val-(relativeCharge h S+1)

Bosonize.Ch07.excitation_nat_cast.text: lemma excitation_nat_cast (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (S : Occupation h) : (excitationNat h S : ℤ) = excitationEnergy h S

Bosonize.Ch07.excitation_nonneg.text: lemma excitation_nonneg (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (S : Occupation h) : 0 ≤ excitationEnergy h S

Bosonize.Ch07.excitation_observable_adjo.text: lemma excitation_observable_adjoint (h : ℕ) : LinearMap.adjoint (excitationObservable h) = excitationObservable h

Bosonize.Ch07.excitation_observable_ket.text: lemma excitation_observable_ket (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) : excitationObservable h (A02.ket S) = (excitationEnergy h S : ℂ) • A02.ket S

Bosonize.Ch07.excitation_zero_iff_ground.text: lemma excitation_zero_iff_ground (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (S : Occupation h) : excitationEnergy h S = 0 ↔ S = groundConfiguration h (relativeCharge h S)

Bosonize.Ch07.excited_configuration_exis.text: lemma excited_configuration_exists (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : -(h : ℤ) < N ∧ N < (h : ℤ)) : ∃ S : Occupation h, relativeCharge h S = N ∧ excitationEnergy h S = 1

Bosonize.Ch07.filtered_budget_map.text: lemma filtered_budget_map (h : ℕ) (A : Operators h) (q d N K : ℤ) (hA : A03.Filtered (relativeCharge h) (excitationEnergy h) A q d) : ∀ v ∈ fixedBudget h N K, A v ∈ fixedBudget h (N+q) (K+d)

Bosonize.Ch07.fixed_projection_adjoint.text: lemma fixed_projection_adjoint (h : ℕ) (N K : ℤ) : LinearMap.adjoint (fixedProjection h N K) = fixedProjection h N K

Bosonize.Ch07.fixed_projection_idempoten.text: lemma fixed_projection_idempotent (h : ℕ) (N K : ℤ) : fixedProjection h N K * fixedProjection h N K = fixedProjection h N K

Bosonize.Ch07.fixed_projection_range.text: lemma fixed_projection_range (h : ℕ) (N K : ℤ) : LinearMap.range (fixedProjection h N K) = fixedBudget h N K

Bosonize.Ch07.frozen_empty.text: lemma frozen_empty (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (S : Occupation h) (N : ℤ) (K : ℕ) (hN : relativeCharge h S = N) (he : excitationEnergy h S ≤ (K : ℤ)) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) (hk : N+(K : ℤ) < k.val) : k ∉ S

Bosonize.Ch07.frozen_full.text: lemma frozen_full (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (S : Occupation h) (N : ℤ) (K : ℕ) (hN : relativeCharge h S = N) (he : excitationEnergy h S ≤ (K : ℤ)) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) (hk : k.val ≤ N-(K : ℤ)) : k ∈ S

Bosonize.Ch07.ground_configuration_card.text: lemma ground_configuration_card (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : admissible h N) : ((groundConfiguration h N).card : ℤ) = (h : ℤ)+N

Bosonize.Ch07.ground_configuration_charg.text: lemma ground_configuration_charge (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : admissible h N) : relativeCharge h (groundConfiguration h N) = N

Bosonize.Ch07.ground_configuration_empty.text: lemma ground_configuration_empty (h : ℕ) : groundConfiguration h (-(h : ℤ)) = ∅

Bosonize.Ch07.ground_configuration_energ.text: lemma ground_configuration_energy (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : admissible h N) : relativeEnergy h (groundConfiguration h N) = groundEnergy N

Bosonize.Ch07.ground_configuration_excit.text: lemma ground_configuration_excitation (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : admissible h N) : excitationEnergy h (groundConfiguration h N) = 0

Bosonize.Ch07.ground_configuration_full.text: lemma ground_configuration_full (h : ℕ) : groundConfiguration h (h : ℤ) = Finset.univ

Bosonize.Ch07.ground_configuration_zero.text: lemma ground_configuration_zero (h : ℕ) : groundConfiguration h 0 = Ch05.seaConfiguration (2*h)

Bosonize.Ch07.ground_energy_unique.text: lemma ground_energy_unique (N t : ℤ) (ht : 2*t = N*(N+1)) : t = groundEnergy N

Bosonize.Ch07.ground_ket_mem_budget.text: lemma ground_ket_mem_budget (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : admissible h N) (K : ℕ) : groundKet h N hN ∈ fixedBudget h N K

Bosonize.Ch07.ground_ket_ne_zero.text: lemma ground_ket_ne_zero (h : ℕ) (N : ℤ) (hN : admissible h N) : groundKet h N hN ≠ 0

Bosonize.Ch07.inadmissible_budget.text: lemma inadmissible_budget (h : ℕ) (N K : ℤ) (hN : ¬ admissible h N) : fixedBudget h N K = ⊥

Bosonize.Ch07.ket_mem_fixed_budget.text: lemma ket_mem_fixed_budget (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) (N K : ℤ) : A02.ket S ∈ fixedBudget h N K ↔ relativeCharge h S = N ∧ excitationEnergy h S ≤ K

Bosonize.Ch07.missing_deep_energy.text: lemma missing_deep_energy (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (S : Occupation h) (K : ℕ) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) (hk : k.val ≤ relativeCharge h S-(K : ℤ)) (hmiss : k ∉ S) : (K : ℤ) < excitationEnergy h S

Bosonize.Ch07.negative_budget.text: lemma negative_budget (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N K : ℤ) (hK : K < 0) : fixedBudget h N K = ⊥

Bosonize.Ch07.negative_shift_annihilates.text: lemma negative_shift_annihilates (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (A : Operators h) (q d N K : ℤ) (hA : A03.Filtered (relativeCharge h) (excitationEnergy h) A q d) (hKd : K+d < 0) : ∀ v ∈ fixedBudget h N K, A v = 0

Bosonize.Ch07.occupied_high_energy.text: lemma occupied_high_energy (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (S : Occupation h) (K : ℕ) (k : Ch01.Band (2*h)) (hk : relativeCharge h S+(K : ℤ) < k.val) (hocc : k ∈ S) : (K : ℤ) < excitationEnergy h S

Bosonize.Ch07.relative_hamiltonian_diago.text: lemma relative_hamiltonian_diagonal (h : ℕ) : Ch05.shiftedHamiltonian (2*h) = A03.diagonal (fun S => (relativeEnergy h S : ℂ))

Bosonize.Ch07.sorted_mode_lower_bound.text: lemma sorted_mode_lower_bound (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) (i : Fin S.card) : referenceMode h S i ≤ (sortedMode h S i).val

Bosonize.Ch07.sorted_mode_mem.text: lemma sorted_mode_mem (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) (i : Fin S.card) : sortedMode h S i ∈ S

Bosonize.Ch07.sorted_mode_strict_mono.text: lemma sorted_mode_strict_mono (h : ℕ) (S : Occupation h) : StrictMono (fun i => (sortedMode h S i).val)

Bosonize.Ch07.species_budget_ket.text: lemma species_budget_ket (h : ℕ) (S : A02.Occupation (σ × Ch01.Band (2*h))) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℤ) : A02.ket S ∈ speciesBudget h Ns K ↔ (∀ ν, relativeCharge h (speciesConfiguration h S ν) = Ns ν) ∧ totalExcitation h S ≤ K

Bosonize.Ch07.species_budget_negative.text: lemma species_budget_negative (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (Ns : σ → ℤ) (K : ℤ) (hK : K < 0) : speciesBudget h Ns K = ⊥

Bosonize.Ch07.total_excitation_nonneg.text: lemma total_excitation_nonneg (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (S : A02.Occupation (σ × Ch01.Band (2*h))) : 0 ≤ totalExcitation h S

Bosonize.Ch07.vacuum_charge.text: lemma vacuum_charge (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) : relativeCharge h (Ch05.seaConfiguration (2*h)) = 0

Bosonize.Ch07.vacuum_excitation.text: lemma vacuum_excitation (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) : excitationEnergy h (Ch05.seaConfiguration (2*h)) = 0

Bosonize.Ch07.vacuum_ket_mem_box.text: lemma vacuum_ket_mem_box (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (K Nmax : ℕ) : vacuumKet h ∈ boxBudget h K Nmax

Bosonize.Ch07.word_window_in_band.text: lemma word_window_in_band (h M K Nmax : ℕ) (N j : ℤ) (ds : List ℤ) (hN : |N| ≤ (Nmax : ℤ)) (hmargin : A03.wordCutoff h M K Nmax ds) (hj : N-(K : ℤ)-A03.upwardExcursion ds-(M : ℤ)+1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ N+(K : ℤ)+A03.upwardExcursion ds+(M : ℤ)) : Ch01.inBandPredicate (2*h) j

Bosonize.Ch07.zero_budget_ground_span.text: lemma zero_budget_ground_span (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : admissible h N) : fixedBudget h N 0 = Submodule.span ℂ {groundKet h N hN}

Bosonize.Ch07.zero_energy_dimension_one.text: lemma zero_energy_dimension_one (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (N : ℤ) (hN : admissible h N) : Module.finrank ℂ (energySpace h N 0) = 1
